prepared by arc melting under a high-purity argon atmosphere in a water-chilled copper crucible. The purity of each raw material was at least 99.9 weight percent (wt%). Ingots were remelted five times to ensure chemical homogeneity and then cast into a rectangular plate
All ingots were homogenized at 1200 ℃ for 5 h, named homogeneous alloy.
cold-rolling was conducted with a total thickness reduction ratio of 70 % at room temperature before annealing. The thickness decreased from 3 mm to 0.9 mm.
